title: Schedule of Reschedule Allowances: Delivery & Pickup Appointments
content:
A customer who reschedules a Delivery & Pickup Appointment is subject to the allowances set out below for the appointment's fulfillment method. They fix how many customer-initiated reschedules are free, the fee for each reschedule after those, the most reschedules allowed, and the notice required before the booked window.

| Fulfillment method | Free customer reschedules per appointment | Fee for each reschedule beyond the free ones | Most customer reschedules per appointment | Notice required before the start of the booked window | Reschedule forced by a severe-weather advisory free and not counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | 2 | $25.00 | 4 | 24 hours | Yes |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | 3 | $0.00 | 5 | 4 hours | Yes |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | 1 | $75.00 | 2 | 72 hours | Yes |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | 2 | $49.00 | 4 | 24 hours | Yes |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | 1 | $99.00 | 2 | 48 hours | Yes |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | 1 | $149.00 | 2 | 72 hours | Yes |

### Terms used in this schedule

- **Free customer reschedules**: the number of customer-initiated reschedules per appointment that carry no charge.
- **Fee for each reschedule beyond the free ones**: the amount billed for each further customer-initiated reschedule, in US dollars.
- **Most customer reschedules**: the greatest number of customer-initiated reschedules one appointment can have.
- **Notice required**: the number of hours before the start of the booked window by which a reschedule must be requested.
- **Weather column**: "Yes" means a reschedule forced by a severe-weather advisory is free and does not count toward the free or maximum reschedules.

### Reading across the methods (figures from the table)

| Fulfillment method | Reschedules that can carry the fee | Most reschedule fees one appointment can carry, in total |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | the 3rd and 4th | $50.00 |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | the 4th and 5th, at $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | the 2nd | $75.00 |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | the 3rd and 4th | $98.00 |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | the 2nd | $99.00 |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | the 2nd | $149.00 |

Each total is the number of reschedules that can carry the fee (the most customer reschedules, less the free ones) multiplied by that method's fee per reschedule.
